headline: Reddit Mandates Log-Ins to Block AI Scraping as Search Traffic Declines
summary: Reddit will require visitors to sign in to access content, ending two decades of open browsing. The policy shift comes as search traffic falls and the company seeks to protect platform content from unauthorized artificial intelligence scraping.
why: Reddit's content licensing and user traffic determine its digital advertising and data monetisation prospects amid growing data extraction by competing AI model developers.

impacts.name: Reddit Inc.
impacts.why: Login walls may lower public search visitor volume while improving proprietary data protection and user monetization.
